description: This file defines the InProcessSiloHandle class, which manages the lifecycle of an in-process Orleans silo, including creation, stopping, disposal, and logging.

classes.name: InProcessSiloHandle
classes.description: A handle for managing an in-process Orleans silo, including creation, stopping, disposal, and logging functionalities.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and initializes a new in-process silo handle.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo asynchronously, with an option for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo asynchronously using a CancellationToken.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the silo handle, stopping the silo if active and releasing resources.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the silo handle, stopping the silo if active.
